title: Statistics Quiz
description: Practice finding the mean, median, mode and range, and choosing the right average for a set of data.

questions.question: What is the mean of 2, 4, 6 and 8?
questions.explanation: Add them up: 2 + 4 + 6 + 8 = 20. There are 4 numbers, so the mean is 20 ÷ 4 = 5.

questions.question: What is the median of 3, 9, 4, 7, 5?
questions.explanation: Put the numbers in order first: 3, 4, 5, 7, 9. The middle value is 5. Picking 4 means you forgot to sort them.

questions.question: What is the mode of 2, 5, 3, 5, 7, 2, 5?
questions.explanation: The mode is the value that appears most often. 5 appears three times, more than any other number.

questions.question: What is the median of 8, 2, 10, 6?
questions.explanation: In order, the numbers are 2, 6, 8, 10. There are two middle values, 6 and 8, so the median is (6 + 8) ÷ 2 = 7.

questions.question: The mean of five numbers is 12. What do the five numbers add up to?
questions.explanation: Mean = total ÷ how many numbers, so total = mean × how many numbers. 12 × 5 = 60.

questions.question: On one street, most houses cost about the same but one house costs far more than the rest. Which average gives the fairest picture of a typical house price?
questions.explanation: One very high price pulls the mean up a lot. The median is just the middle value, so it hardly changes. The range is not an average at all.

questions.question: Four test scores have a mean of 15. Three of the scores are 12, 18 and 14. What is the fourth score?
questions.explanation: The four scores must add up to 15 × 4 = 60. The three you know add up to 12 + 18 + 14 = 44. So the fourth score is 60 − 44 = 16.

questions.question: For the numbers 4, 7, 7, 10, 22, what are the mean and the median?
questions.explanation: The total is 4 + 7 + 7 + 10 + 22 = 50, and 50 ÷ 5 = 10, so the mean is 10. The numbers are already in order, and the middle one is 7, so the median is 7.

questions.question: A class of 10 students has a mean test score of 70. A new student joins and scores 92. What is the new mean for all 11 students?
questions.explanation: The 10 students scored 10 × 70 = 700 in total. Adding 92 gives 792. There are now 11 students, so the new mean is 792 ÷ 11 = 72.
